title: Yaya Diaby, Chris Godwin set to play for Buccaneers on Sunday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Yaya Diaby, Chris Godwin set to play for Buccaneers on Sunday
sources.description: The Buccaneers will have linebacker Yaya Diaby and wide receiver Chris Godwin in the lineup as they try for their first win of the season against the Packers on Sunday.
